{{Top|leg}}
'''Ordnandell''' was an astronomical object in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], there was a shipping accident in [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] near Ordnandell, which delayed some [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] in their work. A [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]], referred to as the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''something-or-other Falcon'']] dropped its cargo to escape an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] boarding party.<ref name="RPG">[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game (first edition)|''Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game'']]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Remember when you had to take the long way around to get to Ordnandell? Well it turns out that there was a shipping accident in hyperspace. Some Corellian freighter, the ''something-or-other Falcon'', dumped its cargo to escape an Imperial boarding party.|A Gamemaster explaining a situation to their players|<ref name="RPG" />}}
Ordnandell was first mentioned in the [[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game (first edition)|first edition]] of ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' published by [[West End Games]] in [[October]] [[1987]].<ref name="RPG" />

Although Ordnandell originated from an official source,<ref name="RPG" /> [[Jason Fry]], co-author of ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', indicated in [[June]] [[2015]] that its name was omitted from [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|''The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion]] at the request of [[Lucasfilm]] in order to avoid confusion with [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]].<ref name="Email">{{EmailCite|email=File:EAOC discussion.jpg|creator=Jason Fry|date=2015-06-30}}</ref>
